title: Create and verify Zedu's Google Business Profile, by Fri 13 Nov
description: No Google Business Profile was found for Zedu, a Lagos-based company selling to schools and bootcamps that often search locally. Create the profile, complete verification, and keep name, address, category and description consistent with the website and the EdTech directory-listing goal. Deliverable: the verified profile link and a consistency check against existing listings.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Check eligibility first: Google only allows profiles for businesses with in-person contact
acceptedWorkstreams.description: Google's Business Profile guidelines say online-only businesses aren't eligible; a business needs a staffed location customers can visit, or must serve customers at their location (service-area business). Creating an ineligible profile risks suspension. Tasks: (1) confirm with the team in writing whether Zedu has a staffed Lagos office open to customers or runs on-site visits to schools; (2) if yes, draft the profile with the exact name, category, address or service area and description matching the website and directory listings, and hand it to the team to create and verify (verification needs their phone or postcard); (3) if no, record why and move the effort to Bing Places and other eligible profiles under the profiles goal.
